items.criterion: The run ends only in an end state: each change is proposed, or a commit "Stop <id>: <why>" records the stop. It does not end with work half done and no stop record.
A stop gives the user a clear decision. The reply and "Open" in the handoff give the reason in one sentence, the decision, and a recommended answer that obeys the pdlc rules.
Ship does not settle a contradiction by default. It stops and leaves the choice to the user.
Ship continues from the latest handoff and does not run a finished stage again.
Each stage leaves the commit subjects and trailers of its own skill, in the order of "Stages and handoffs".
A case that is not a stop (no remote, a slow agent, a choice of name) does not stop the run.
At the end, `git status --porcelain` is empty, and each commit has the trailers of "Commits".
The last reply lists the changes in stack order with their proposals and GIFs. It also lists each answer taken by default, and what waits for the user.
